whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Picante,

I noticed your restaurant has amazing 4.5★ ratings across 1,000+ reviews in Anisabad, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and table reservation page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, digital food menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/picante

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
Hi Team The Picante, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (The Picante) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? 

[If checked]: Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking and digital menu features for your Anisabad location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?

[If not checked]: No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai. Agar aapko design pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items aur actual photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
